name: Ollama
summary: Ollama downloads and runs open-weight models on your own machine with one command and serves them on a local REST API. It also exposes a subset of the OpenAI API, so most agent tools can point at it unchanged. A paid Ollama cloud offers larger models on the same interface.
facts: Native REST on localhost:11434; OpenAI-compatible /v1 subset
Free tier; Pro $20, Max $100, Team $500 per month
goodFor: Running open models offline on a laptop or workstation
Private data that must not leave the machine
Local development against an OpenAI-style API
watchOut: Quality and speed are bounded by your hardware
OpenAI compatibility is a subset; Responses API is stateless
Single-machine serving, not built for high-concurrency production
